person.bibl: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
Descriptive Catalogue of Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Adyar Library (Adyar). Vols. 1–13.
Krishnamacharya, V. ‘Śāstradīpikāvyākhyā: Prabhāmaṇḍala’. In The Adyar Library Bulletin, Vol. 10, pp. 63–68, 1946.
person.note: For the alternative name Kṛṣṇānandayati, see Descriptive Catalogue of Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Adyar Library (Adyar). Vols. 1–13: vol. 9, p. 349.
For the alternative names Kṛṣṇānandaguru and Kṛṣṇānandapūjyapāda, see Krishnamacharya, V. ‘Śāstradīpikāvyākhyā: Prabhāmaṇḍala’. In The Adyar Library Bulletin, Vol. 10, pp. 63–68, 1946.

He was the pupil of Rāmabhadrānanda Sarasvatī in Vedānta, and Vāsudevendra Sarasvatī with regard to the saṁnyāsaśrama. See Descriptive Catalogue of Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Adyar Library (Adyar). Vols. 1–13: vol. 9, pp. 466–468.

Some of the leading writers of Thiruvisanallur looked to his blessings. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 30.
He was active c. the last quarter of the 17th century and beginning of the 18th century. See New Catalogus Catalogurum (NCC). Vols 1-36: vol. 5, p. 14a.

He was the teacher of Anubhavānanda, Raṅganāthasūri, Viśvanātha Dīkṣita, Bhāskara Dīkṣita, Periyappākavi, Ayya Adhvarin, Brahmānanda, Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita, and Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. See New Catalogus Catalogurum (NCC). Vols 1-36: vol. 5, p. 14a.
